description: Boot sequence on 2026-05-27 executed Phase 1 (identity load) but skipped the majority of Phase 2 and all subsequent phases. Steps skipped: git sync, dream summary check, Plaud ingest (background agent), Teams transcript ingest, lead review workflow, 72-hour look-ahead, email triage, Jarvis inbox, Clay reminders/birthdays, working memory write. Morning briefing was not synthesized. Boot was reported as complete when it was not.
correction: All skipped Phase 2 steps must be executed every boot — no exceptions, no silent skips. Each step must report completed, nothing to surface, or failed with reason. User had to explicitly identify the skips and request remediation.
systemic_fix: Boot sequence steps should be tracked via a checklist written to a temp state file at boot start, with each step marking itself complete. Rigby should audit the boot checklist at session close and flag any incomplete steps.
